# Copilot instructions for hashbin.org

Follow [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at the repository root. It covers the repository map,
commands, conventions, generated files, and how `STATUS.md` and the `todo/`/`done/` plans
are kept current. Project status lives only in [`STATUS.md`](../STATUS.md).

Before finishing a change, run `npm run test:unit` and `npm run lint`.
